title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Apple 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Apple E-Liquid brings a crisp orchard twist to the legendary Pinkman profile. This blend is anchored by the signature Pinkman foundation of sweet Red Berries, merging the familiar taste of Strawberry and Raspberry with those characteristic zesty Citrus undertones. To this established classic, Vampire Vape layers the sharp, refreshing taste of Green Apple. The bright, tangy notes of the Apple cut through the sweetness of the berry mix, adding a clean, crisp finish that balances the profile perfectly. It creates a vibrant fruit blend that offers complexity without being overly sweet. This 10ml freebase e-liquid is available in a versatile range of nicotine strengths, including 0mg, 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg. Please note that Vampire Vape adjusts the VG/PG ratio depending on the nicotine strength selected: 3mg is mixed at 50VG/50PG, making it ideal for most starter kits and pod vape kits. 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg are mixed at 40VG/60PG, which provides a sharper throat hit and is best suited for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) starter kits and lower-powered devices.
